$comment: Warnings of the official HL7 FHIR validator that CI accepts. An entry gives a text (a substring of the issue text), a messageId (exact), or both, and optionally a file (a path suffix) that restricts it to one validated file; a warning matches when it satisfies every key the entry gives. Match on text: the validator 7.0.1 that CI runs writes no message id, other versions do. Each entry needs the reason why the warning does not indicate a defect. Entries that match no warning fail CI, so the list never goes stale.

warnings.text: Constraint failed: dom-6: 'A resource should have narrative for robust management'
warnings.reason: Best-practice invariant: a resource should have a narrative. The converter writes data, not human-readable text; a generated narrative would only repeat the data, and the receiving system renders it as it needs.

warnings.text: In general, all observations should have a performer
warnings.reason: Best-practice recommendation. The performer comes from OBX-16 (responsible observer), which the sample messages leave empty; the converter does not invent one.

warnings.text: In general, all observations should have an effective[x]
warnings.reason: Best-practice recommendation. The time comes from OBX-14, or from the time of its order (OBR-7, OBR-8); an observation of an ADT message without OBX-14 has none, and the converter does not invent one.

The guide maps CX.5 to the code system v2-0203, whose code SS (social security number) the R4 identifier-type value set lacks. The binding is extensible and the converter keeps the code of the guide instead of dropping it to fit the R4 value set.

warnings.text: No code provided, and a code should be provided from the value set 'IdentifierType'
warnings.reason: Only the deliberately invalid sample has this: its CX.5 is QQ, which is not in table 0203. The converter keeps just type.text and reports UNMAPPED_CODE (see invalid-adt-a01.issues.txt), so the identifier type has no code.
